senses.sense_definition: A self-contained utopian community organized according to the social theories of Charles Fourier.

examples.text: The 19th-century reformer attempted to establish an agrarian <w>phalanstery</w> in the countryside.
Members of the proposed <w>phalanstery</w> shared resources and rotated unpleasant tasks among themselves.

traits.comment: Primarily used in 19th-century historical and philosophical contexts

senses.sense_definition: The large communal building or dwelling complex designed to house a Fourierist community.

examples.text: The architect drafted blueprints for a grand <w>phalanstery</w> that included both workshops and residential wings.
Hundreds of workers and their families lived under the roof of the sprawling <w>phalanstery</w>.

traits.comment: Primarily used in 19th-century historical and philosophical contexts
